user.description: Hold the top button on the Dohm for ~5 seconds to make it discoverable, then select it.

name.title: Name this Dohm
name.description:
Setting up {name}.

Give it a name you'd actually say out loud — it becomes the device name and the entity name, so it's what voice assistants listen for. If you have more than one, name them after where they are.

data_description.name: For example: Bedroom Dohm
data_description.area: Optional. You can move it later without this being reapplied.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Dohm devices found. Hold the top button for ~5 seconds to make it discoverable, then try again.

menu_options.rebond: Clear the pairing and pair again

rebond.title: Clear the pairing and pair again
rebond.description:
Use this only if the Dohm shows as unavailable and stays that way. The Dohm replies only over a paired (encrypted) link, so if Home Assistant is holding a pairing key the device no longer accepts, it will connect and then never answer.

This clears the key from Home Assistant's side and asks for a new one. The Dohm only grants a pairing while in pairing mode, so hold the top button for ~5 seconds first.

If the Dohm is simply slow or out of range, do nothing — Home Assistant keeps retrying on its own, and clearing a pairing that still works means another trip to the top button.

abort.rebond_failed: Re-pairing did not complete. Check the logs for the error, and make sure the Dohm is powered and in range.
abort.rebond_unsupported: This Dohm is reached through an adapter that cannot clear pairings. A local Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome proxy with the pairing feature enabled can do it.
